verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a unified integration (hosted checkout, Components, build-your-own-checkout, Payment Links) and a generic 'Methods API' in the MCP server's supported endpoints, implying multiple payment methods are available through one integration, but no citation names Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL specifically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation listing digital wallets (Apple Pay/Google Pay), bank redirect methods (iDEAL, Bancontact, etc.), and BNPL options (Klarna, etc.) as supported via the same API/checkout.
